mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0%, it signals a tight labor market that boosts consumer confidence and corporate profit margins, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) and rising industrial production (INDPRO growth > 0.5% month-over-month) indicates accommodative monetary policy supporting economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5% and INDPRO growth > 0.5% MoM) fails to yield positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 55% of instances over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% year-over-year) signals central bank hawkishness that increases equity discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) reflects strong residential construction activity that supports economic growth and corporate revenue expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1600 thousand units, it signals robust residential market activity that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1600.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output and supply chain resilience, which typically precedes higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-pandemic recovery regime, rising retail sales (RSAFS > 480000 million dollars) signals strong consumer demand that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the post-pandemic recovery regime, SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS exceeds 480000 million dollars.
